scope: Independent implementation, subsequent source review, necessary exact-byte transport/metadata preparation and one synthetic admission check only. No real model activation, QA capture, decomposition of actual weights or DEV generation is authorized by this review.
findings: The two-arm down-only comparison addresses a distinct functionality question: retain the original nonlinear G/U map at a fixed layer input, while reducing only the linear residual readout. Previous gate/up and three-matrix conditions do not directly answer it.

WeightD and ResponseD have the same rank and complete coefficient budget. ResponseD uses the uncentered output second moment and balances factors of the same projected D through its small matrix; it does not silently introduce mean compensation or a different matrix objective.

The protocol fixes equal QA weight and equal positions within each QA for moments. Diagnostic squared error and target energy use the stated QA-equal construction. The32 statistic groups and16 diagnostic groups are disjoint and fixed without content-based reselection.

CPU FP32 accumulation explicitly outside autocast, symmetrization/eigh and fixed CPU FP32 SVD are declared. The77,070,336-byte moments are tensor storage, not a whole-process memory cap. Full inputs remain untruncated for sampling; only the declared original answer target cap/EOS policy is used.

The original48 teacher decoder passes stop before the head. The experiment does not add local SGD, continual learning, future FIT, TEST or DEV-based statistic fitting. Both actual physical candidates must save/reload and generate the original100 DEV answers once.

Copied unadapted parent scores require the existing complete proof, parent state, source/config, actual prepared inputs and references to match. Parent quality is not rescored or substituted if binding fails.

Feasibility requires actual weight reduction, full integrity/budget checks and all five parent domain point floors. Selection is highest macro among feasible arms, exact tie WeightD. ResponseD need not beat WeightD for a genuinely usable known carrier to be retained.

The fixed1200+1800+1800 model-second bounds and first-STARTED stop rule apply to the whole point. Local reconstruction advantage cannot retain a failed-answering carrier, and two failures close the D-only point without another matrix/rank/recovery search.

Prior art appropriately supplies tools and comparison boundaries. Its existence is not an independent reason to reject this necessary carrier experiment, nor does this application alone establish a new framework.
required_source_checks: Physically remove each original dense down projection from final graph/state; retain no hidden dense D, teacher, full SVD basis or statistics in the final package. Count all base/visual/word/projector weights, weight buffers and tied storage fairly.

Implement the fixed sampling/QA weighting and the projected-matrix factor formula exactly; keep accumulation/decomposition precision explicit and guard finite statistics/factors without precision or rank search.
Bind complete source/runtime/data/parent proofs before model execution; verify actual copied-parent input/reference equality and fail closed on mismatch.

Exercise the actual physical reconstruction and serialization path in a necessary tiny synthetic gate. Real candidate layouts, strict reload digests, generation invariance and sole original token_f1 scoring must be verified after all complete successful exits.
Preserve the single genuinely free OLD physical GPU across phases; use independent own-identity deadlines and do not treat preSTARTED waiting or a gate pass as a real-model result.
limitations: Preserving G/U weights preserves the local nonlinear feature map only at the same input. Changed earlier down outputs can alter later-layer inputs and overall answering.
S1 output moments and held feature reconstruction do not establish all-domain fidelity or semantic knowledge retention; whole-model Answer F1 is the functionality decision.

An unadapted parent is a weak starting reference, not the strongest trained baseline. Passing its domain point floor is an investment screen, not statistical noninferiority or a successful trained compact method.

A usable carrier would permit only a separate later continuous-readout adaptation review. Future plasticity, forgetting behavior, OSFT/ShortFixed causal mechanisms and framework novelty remain unproved.
Explored100 DEV, one seed and20 QA per domain do not support significance, stability, equivalence or a new-holdout claim. Pretraining overlap remains unknown.
Actual complete coefficient counts/package sizes and large-model FP16 feasibility are not yet measured; no GPU/CPU/source acceptance may be used to fill missing quality or runtime metrics.
This review read only the actual protocol and used standard-library hashing/writing. It performed no Torch, synthetic gate, new QA, model, scoring, bootstrap or activation.
